verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own OAuth implementation in which third-party applications request scoped access to a user's data through Clerk's API. It also supports OAuth client registration via Client ID Metadata Documents and Dynamic Client Registration, a device authorization grant for browserless clients, and custom OAuth scopes, which together cover the core of acting as an OAuth provider. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the 'Sign in with my app' / OIDC identity-provider flow (consent screen, ID-token issuance, manual client creation outside the MCP context), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
